subject.title: fix(providers): publish Meta under canonical package name

question: Should this PR land the current-main Meta provider as bundled plus `@openclaw/meta-provider` npm/ClawHub distribution under the canonical `meta` id after the docs formatting fix?
rationale: The code path is coherent, but provider id, auth, package publishing, and dependency surfaces are release/security choices that CI cannot fully settle.

options.title: Accept canonical publish path
options.body: Fix the docs formatting blocker, then land the canonical bundled `meta` provider and `@openclaw/meta-provider` npm/ClawHub publish metadata.

options.title: Defer package publishing
options.body: Keep the bundled `meta` rename but disable or postpone npm/ClawHub publish flags until the release train explicitly validates the package.

options.title: Move external only
options.body: Pause or replace this PR with an external-only provider package if maintainers do not want the bundled-core provider exception.

recommendation.title: Accept canonical publish path
recommendation.body: Fix the docs formatting blocker, then land the canonical bundled `meta` provider and `@openclaw/meta-provider` npm/ClawHub publish metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current release/package follow-up PR and is identified by the dependency guard as the trusted secops actor for the dependency graph change.
